# Permanent numerical regression references

These historical derived snapshots are test-only scientific evidence, not inputs
required by the modern FCC Al workflow. Bytes are preserved unchanged. Recreating
them would require historical preparation settings or private predecessor execution;
modern tests regenerate inexpensive synthetic data separately.

- `FOR0013.DAT`: Recorded potential/scattering/phase-grating numerical reference.
- `FOR007.DAT`: Historical model and refinement/parser contract reference.
- `STARTINGFOR007.DAT`: Starting-state parsing and scan/refinement reference.
- `bestin.dat`: Historical experimental/intensity scaling reference.
- `firstout.dat`: Recorded intensity objective/output comparison reference.
- `in.dat`: Prepared intensity/header compatibility and objective reference.
- `inputparams.dat`: Recorded scan-coordinate conversion reference.
- `sigma.dat`: Recorded empirical noise association reference (not a modern preparation prerequisite).
- `startingin.dat`: Starting experimental/intensity normalization reference.
- `out.dat`: Empty historical result used to distinguish absent executable-reference evidence.
